fittingEvidence.scope: 24-row stratified live paired development capture (v3 gold, code-executed-v8); development fitting evidence only, NOT holdout qualification

fittingRule: A capability threshold is FITTED only if some threshold achieves Wilson-95 lower-bound precision >= 0.95 on the fitting evidence with n >= 10 accepted predictions; otherwise the engineering default is retained and marked UNFITTED (never silently fitted, never retroactively picked after holdout inspection).

productTypeChoice.evidence: n=21 proposals, 19 hits; best Wilson LB 0.796 at t=0.95 (15/15); two high-confidence over-proposals on insufficient-evidence gold (P=0.87, 0.92 → dog-treats) poison all thresholds below 0.95
productTypeChoice.failureMode: insufficient-evidence rows over-proposed at high vendor probability on both legs (reproduces the 3-row diagnostic)

singleValueAttributes.evidence: sample positives: species 16 (mostly invariant), food-form 5, life-stage 2; no per-target n>=10 variable-positive support; flavor/breed-size/packaging/fuel/hose zero positives in sample

multiValueNoul.evidence: insufficient per-target variable-positive support in the 24-row sample (see singleValueAttributes)

categoryPages.evidence: n=12 page predictions on known-complete gold, 10 hits, best Wilson LB 0.552 at t=0.5; recall 10/14 = 0.714 at t=0.5; 6 sample rows excluded (non-complete gold)

abstentionSemantics: UNCHANGED: no_match/insufficient_evidence earn correctness only against matching gold; low-probability/uncoded/service-failure abstentions never credit; code-executed-v8 semantic codes retained.
deferredTo: qualifying-scale development evidence (per-capability n>=60 clean accepts for Wilson-0.95 viability) — NOT to holdout inspection; thresholds stay at engineering defaults until then.
